plainText:
Kazalie (Japanese: カザリー Kazarī) is a minor recurring character in . She is a Pokémon Performer.

==History==
Kazalie first appeared in Master Class Choices!, where she was first seen competing in the Fleurrh City Rookie Class Pokémon Showcase. In the Theme Performance round, she competed against and Concetta, but was unable to proceed.

She reappeared in Master Class Is in Session!, where she competed in the Master Class Pokémon Showcase in Gloire City. However, Kazalie was either eliminated in the first round or the second round.

===Other achievements===
Kazalie has competed in the following Rookie Class tournaments:
Showcase - Theme Performance (Master Class Choices!)
